rules.statement: The principle of enormis laesio is applicable to a lease as much as to a sale, but for this purpose the difference in value should exist at the time of the lease or sale and not thereafter.
rules.supporting_quote: For this purpose the difference in value should exist at the time of the lease or sale and not thereafter. (Grotius' Introduction 3, 52, 2; Walter Pereira's Laws of Ceylon 657.)
